facts.fact_text: On 24 February 2014 the applicants participated in a spontaneous gathering in front of the Zamoskvoretskiy District Court of Moscow.
On the morning of 24 February 2014 the applicants were among some 150 people who came to the Zamoskvoretskiy District Court of Moscow.
The applicants remained outside the Zamoskvoretskiy District Court of Moscow among other members of the public who were also aspiring to attend the hearing, thus forming a gathering.
The applicants were arrested during the gathering in front of the Zamoskvoretskiy District Court of Moscow on 24 February 2014.
The applicants were convicted of administrative offences following their arrest during the gathering on 24 February 2014.
At different times the applicants were arrested and transferred to a police station following the gathering outside the Zamoskvoretskiy District Court of Moscow on 24 February 2014.
